title: 粉碎打击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：上、左、右。上段、左斩后，以右斩收尾，用剑柄击中对手面部。
second_page: 粉碎打击是短剑击中敌人面部的招式，只把最后一击砸实，轻松的惩罚所有不喜欢保护面部的敌人。翻到这里，你已经开始练习粉碎打击。

en_us.title: Crushing Blow
en_us.first_page: Input: Up, Left, Right. After an overhead and left cut, finish from the right and smash the pommel into the opponent's face.
en_us.second_page: Crushing Blow is a short-sword technique aimed at the face. Commit to the final blow to punish enemies who leave their face exposed.
